key_findings: Rbfox1 is reduced in injured DRG neurons after SNL/CCI; rescuing it with AAV5-Rbfox1 blunts development and maintenance of pain hypersensitivity, while knockdown produces pain in naive mice.
Reduced Rbfox1 increases inclusion of exon 10 in Nrcam, raising long Nrcam variants and lowering short variants in injured DRG.
